items.label: Fabric
items.value: This sleeveless tank body suit is made of 75% Nylon&25% Spandex. The fabric is soft, lightweight, stretch, breathable and skin-friendly, comfortable to wear and touch. Snap-closure at the bottom makes this bodysuit very easy to wear.

items.label: Womens Outfits
items.value: Double lined and thick material to prevent see-through,and holds your “girls”in place so well. Ultra stretchy gets more support and secure, not see through even in white color. Thong bottom giving you maximum freedom of movement.

items.label: Features
items.value: Sleeveless/Square Neck/Tank Top/Low Back/Snap Closure/Double Layer/Thong Bottom. This women's sleeveless tank top bodysuit front square neck and low back cut, which gives a fun twist to this simple basic, and perfect for going out.

items.label: Occasion
items.value: Cute and Casual for going out.Women's square neck bodysuit is perfect for any occasion, whether it's daily wear, shopping, beach, club, party, work, dating, vacation, street, holiday and so on. It goes well with jeans, skirts, shorts, skinny pants, coat and blazers, etc.
